remarks: Rowayton, a seaside village just 1 hour from NYC, is a Fairfield County gem. This prized 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home beautifully maintained home, located in the highly desirable Rowayton Beach Association (RBA), is now for rent. Features include a stunning high-end kitchen adjacent to family room with wood burning fireplace. Generous living room, dining room with sliders leads to bluestone patio, an ideal spot for warm-weather entertaining, Two sets of washer/dryer units on first and second floor. All closets custom with extensive built-ins. Two-car garage. Located just a short walk from the RBA's private beach and the center of town. Rowayton living at its best.  Note: Available 12 to 16 months.
